units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 4:1:3">Y. Maasr. IV, beg., 51ᵃ</cite> <he>המְהַבְהֵב שיבולין באור</he> if one parches ears over the fire; <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 3:1">Tosef. ib. III, 1</cite> <he>המה׳ בשדה וכ׳</he> (sub. <he>שיבולין</he>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:3">Sabb. II, 3</cite> <he>ולא הִבְהֲבָהּ</he> and did not singe it (to prepare it for a wick).—
Snh. 37ᵃ is it possible for fire to be in contact with flax ואינה מְהַבְהֶבֶת and not to singe?—Part. pass. מְהוּבְהָב lightly roasted. Y. ib. VIII, beg., 26ᵃ

senses.gloss: to be like coals giving heat without flame; to nod consent without showing anxiety.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 34a:4">Ber. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>שנים מהבהב</he> (Y. ib. V, 9ᶜ bot. <he>מעמעם</he>) if asked a second time, he must not consent &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 41b:10">Yoma 41ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ הלשון</he> if the band caught fire.
